name: sample-sanitizer
description: Turn a real log sample into a shareable, de-identified sample — entirely on-box, with no AI. Select a file (or paste / pull worker-group events), review the detected identifiers, sanitise, then download or save to a shared per-worker-group sanitised-sample library. Built from the same sanitise engine as the Cribl Pack Generator.
author: Wilfred van der Linde - wlinde@cribl.io
